name: TMI-2
english_description: A historically significant, widely-copied English-language LPMud mudlib from 1992-1996 whose std/ base classes, command-soul dispatch, and /adm/-rooted security-daemon layout were inherited by a large family of later mudlibs (this project's own catalog refers to a 'TMI-2/Falcon family' of descendants). This port is the 'famous TMI-2 quad' release: a landing zone with a bulletin board and discussion rooms, the full wizard toolset, and character creation across 13 playable races. The most severe porting bug: master.lpc's domain_file() crashed with an uncaught array-index-out-of-bounds error on the driver's own first boot-time call, because this driver's SANE_EXPLODE_STRING build returns an empty array from explode('/','/') where old-style MudOS returned a two-element one -- the existing null-check never covered the empty case, and the failure happened so early in boot that the top-level error message gave no indication of the real cause. A second bug: two live-loaded files (the channel daemon and the wizard reference-variable daemon) used 'ref' as an ordinary identifier, a name this driver reserves as a pass-by-reference keyword.
